acceptanceCriteria: A qrels-shaped fixture round-trips through the runner and reports recall, MRR, NDCG@k and MAP with the existing comparability block.
The mapping rule is a numbered requirement with a test showing an unmappable row scored as a miss.
Existing frozen benchmark outputs are byte-identical for the existing metrics.
body: Owner requested this on 2026-09-23 after reviewing Tencent/WeKnora (MIT) as prior art; this ticket records an idea, not delivery or promotion. Original Go work only; no source import. WeKnora is an LLM-at-ingest, database-backed RAG platform, so only the mechanism is borrowed and it must stay deterministic, local and read-only under AGENTS.md invariants 4 and 7. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Prior art: website-docs/03-features/15-evaluation.md of https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora. Custom datasets are five Parquet files (queries, corpus, answers, qrels, qas) assembled into QAPair records; retrieval metrics are precision, recall, NDCG@3, NDCG@10, MRR and MAP, averaged over queries; the documented pitfall is that retrieved results must be mapped back to dataset passage IDs (they use text containment) or every retrieval metric reads zero. Current state: internal/evalrepo and benchmarks/runner report recall at fixed byte budgets and MRR on Corvint's own frozen benchmark; V1-0097 asks for ContextBench and Agent Retrieval Bench adapters. Idea: accept a BEIR-style qrels shape (queries, corpus, qrels) as the adapter input so V1-0097 becomes a format mapping, add NDCG@k and MAP beside recall and MRR, and write the passage-ID mapping rule into the spec as a requirement with a failure mode: a packet row maps to a benchmark passage only by pinned path and line overlap, and an unmappable row counts as a miss, never as a hit. Generation metrics (BLEU, ROUGE) are out of scope because Corvint does not generate answers. Owning spec: docs/specs/retrieval-eval-comparability-v0.md. Related: V1-0097.
title: eval: qrels dataset shape, NDCG@k and MAP, and an explicit passage-ID mapping rule
